subject.title: Control UI: upload agent avatars from Agents tab

question: Should OpenClaw add a workspace-persistent Agents-tab avatar upload RPC/UI, and what storage, validation, auth, and identity-precedence policy should it use?
rationale: The missing behavior is a useful Control UI feature, but it introduces a new authenticated file-upload and workspace-write path that automation should not design without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve bounded upload design
options.body: Add an operator-admin upload RPC that validates image bytes, writes under a contained workspace avatar path, updates the canonical identity metadata, and keeps the existing avatar route protections.

options.title: Keep current manual/override paths
options.body: Continue supporting CLI/config/IDENTITY.md and browser-local Quick Settings overrides without adding server-side upload risk now.

options.title: Defer to broader identity UX
options.body: Keep this issue open or close it under a broader sponsored Control UI identity-management design rather than adding a one-off upload path.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded upload design
recommendation.body: Add an operator-admin upload RPC that validates image bytes, writes under a contained workspace avatar path, updates the canonical identity metadata, and keeps the existing avatar route protections.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the clearest feature-history owner for agent avatar support and is tied to the original avatar PR merge history.
